text:
Lena (oncall): PagerDuty fired: billing-metering-alert — token_count_drift > 12% (prod, last 30m). Seeing spike in overage flags. Escalating to incidents channel.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-0427 — billing/metering — Severity: high. Assigned: Lena (oncall), Jamal (billing).

Lena (oncall): quick context — yesterday redeploy of metering-aggregator v2.3 went fine, but rolling metrics show token counts higher than expected vs. model logs. Customers started receiving overage emails ~10:05Z.

Ava (sre): on it. attaching quick query from the ingestion window.
```sql
-- count per host in last 30m
SELECT host, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum, count(*) as events
FROM metering.tokens_raw
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY host
ORDER BY tokens_sum desc
LIMIT 10;
```

Ava (sre): quick grep of logs shows repeated re-ingest attempts from aggregator-host-3 and a Json parse retry loop: "duplicate_batch_id" errors. Looks like dedupe index isn't being applied, so same batch counted twice during a short window.

Jamal (billing): I pulled the reconciliation table. discrepancy_count = 1242 customers affected, avg drift ~ +18% tokens for the 10:00-10:30 window. Delta mainly on high-traffic customers. The overage flags were triggered by rule: if projected_monthly_tokens > committed + 5%.

Ravi (support): getting messages from support — several customers hit immediate throttles and overage warnings. Example: acme-co support ticket #8421: they show sudden spike, asking for immediate credits.

Maya (product): priority = customer-facing impact. If overage emails went out, we need to stop further notifications, estimate billing impact, and prepare customer comms.

Lena (oncall): Triage actions: 1) Pause overage-notify job, 2) Freeze billing export to billing-warehouse, 3) Open rollback/hotfix path for aggregator dedupe, 4) Reprocess window after fix, 5) Draft customer note. Assigning owners now.

ops-bot: Action registered: pause_job(overage-notify) by Lena at 10:20Z — OK.

Jamal (billing): I'm disabling the overage rule temporarily (will toggle to 'monitor-only'). Patch in billing-rules service in flight.

PagerDuty Bot: Handoff reminder: next oncall Jamal will take ownership at 10:30Z.

Lena (oncall): handing off to Jamal for billing. Jamal, confirm you have runbooks for reconciliation and credits.

Jamal (billing): Confirmed. Running quick reconciliation script to compute net token delta per customer for 10:00-10:30 window. Attaching partial output:
```text
customer_id, reported_tokens, expected_tokens, delta
acme-co, 1_230_450, 1_020_000, +210_450
beta-app, 502_120, 422_000, +80_120
... (truncated)
```

Jamal (billing): Proposal: automatically issue pro-rated credits where delta > 50k tokens, and bulk-credit low-delta customers. Will prepare a CSV for finance and support to apply.

Ava (sre): For mitigation — we should: 
- hotfix: re-enable dedupe index application in aggregator (PR ready),
- failover aggregator-host-3 to warm standby,
- replay reingest for window with idempotency enforced.
I can push a hotfix to canary and run a small replay to validate.

Lena (oncall): go ahead. Keep me posted with deploy IDs and checks.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: metering-aggregator@hotfix-dedupe -> canary (deploy id: deploy-1795012-canary). Triggered by Ava at 10:28Z.

Ava (sre): canary looks clean. Replayed sample batch 10:05-10:10, dedupe prevented double-count, counts now match expected.

Ava (sre): initiating full replay for 10:00-10:30 with idempotency flag `--idempotent=true`. Command: 
```bash
./replay_ingest --start "2026-04-27T10:00:00Z" --end "2026-04-27T10:30:00Z" --idempotent=true --workers=8
```

ops-bot: Replay job started (job id: replay-1795012-1). ETA ~ 18 minutes.

Ravi (support): Support to customers: please pause sending overage emails. I'm drafting a short message offering temporary credits while we investigate. Will queue for approval.

Jamal (billing): I'm preparing the credit CSV. Will hold issuing until replay completes and we have confirmed deltas. If replay replays to lower counts, we'll only credit the true excess.

Maya (product): Also want a summary for account teams: which customers saw throttles, whether any SLA impacts (errors/latency) beyond billing, and timeline.

Lena (oncall): quick status: replay progress 40% at 10:45Z. No further overage emails sent (overage-notify paused).

Ava (sre): replay finished. Post-replay reconciliation shows the delta reduced to near-zero for most customers. The duplicate batches were removed; net credit exposure estimated: ~ $1.8k USD across affected accounts (preliminary).

Jamal (billing): CSV finalized with list of customers + proposed credits. I'm going to run apply_credits dry-run then schedule apply. Command: 
```sql
-- sample update
UPDATE customer_billing
SET credit = credit + :credit_amount
WHERE customer_id = :id;
```

Ravi (support): I've sent a support reply to top 20 affected customers offering immediate temporary credits and explaining investigation. Template: "We detected a metering anomaly that may have resulted in incorrect overages. We've paused billing notifications and will apply credits where appropriate. Sorry for the disruption."

Maya (product): Good. Plan for external comms: short status email, then a follow-up postmortem within 72h. Include root cause (dedupe index race on aggregator during recent change) and clear remediation steps.

Lena (oncall): Post-incident tasks: 
- (Ava) Backfill monitoring to detect duplicate_batch_id errors within 1m.
- (Jamal) Add pre-release billing simulation for aggregator changes.
- (Maya) Draft customer comms and coordinate legal/finance.
- (Ravi) Close all support tickets after credit applied.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 updated to status: mitigated at 11:02Z. Root cause: dedupe index not applied in aggregator after v2.3 rollout -> double ingestion.

PagerDuty Bot: Handoff complete. On-call: Jamal (billing) will follow through with billing credits and postmortem.

Lena (oncall): thanks all. I'll file the postmortem draft and tag owners. If anyone sees residual anomalies in reports, ping me directly.

Jamal (billing): will issue credits by EOD and attach audit trail.

Ava (sre): putting hotfix into main and adding unit tests for dedupe flow.

Ravi (support): customers notified; keeping triage channel open for replies.

Maya (product): scheduling postmortem review 72h out.

Lena (oncall): closing channel for now — we'll reopen if we see a regression. Great coordination. :handshake:
